entries.text: It's for a two week trip to Portugal with my wife in November. We fly Air Transat.
A two-week trip to Portugal with your wife in November sounds lovely. Since you're flying Air Transat, is the carry-on size and weight limit a big part of what you're checking?
Mostly, it has to fit the carry on size limit. And be light. I really hate heavy bags.
Heavy bags are the worst, especially when you're travelling for two weeks. Besides HeliumDeploy, what other stores or brands are you comparing the Gatsby with?
I looked at Samsonite on Amazon and something had Costco. But the Bugatti looks nicer.
Samsonite on Amazon, something at Costco, but the Bugatti looks nicer. Good to know. What's holding you back from ordering it today?
Honestly, I just want to know the exact dimensions. And if shipping is fast enough before the trip,

The page should show the dimensions where I pointed. If it doesn't, the product description or the store's policy pages are the place to check. I can't promise delivery dates, but the shipping policy page has the details. With a November flight, when do you need it by?
I saw an Instagram ad a few days ago. That's how I found you.
An Instagram ad, got it, thanks. You said the Bugatti looks nicer than the Samsonite. What about its look appeals to you most?
No. I think that covers it. Thanks a lot. Bye.
Thank you so much for your time, and enjoy Portugal with your wife. Your discount code will appear on screen as soon as you press "End call". Goodbye!
Please press "End call" whenever you're ready, and your code will appear on screen. Thanks again, and have a wonderful trip!
